title: Guard introduced-only pattern enforcement + justification-gate deny message
description:
Guard PreToolUse path for forbidden_pattern: new proposed-content entry point (shape of check_pubspec_raw) — apply the proposed edit in memory, parse result, count query matches; parse on-disk version, count; a blocking pattern constraint denies ONLY if the count increased (introduced-only — grandfathers legacy idiomatic uses). Advisory → stderr as usual. Waived symbols excluded from both counts (needs enclosing-symbol resolution from patterns.rs).

Deny message (format_constraint_deny extension) must teach the justification gate, roughly: "N new match(es) of <name> (<provenance>) at <file>:<line>: <snippet>. If this use is genuinely idiomatic (shared ownership, cheap copy, API requires owned), waive for this symbol via sutra_constraints action=waive with a rationale naming the reason. Otherwise restructure (references/lifetimes) instead of suppressing."

Known accepted limitation (do not fix in this slice): remove-one-add-one nets to zero and passes. Fingerprint-based diff is a designed follow-up if it bites in practice.

Design: sutra/221 implementation_plan. Tests in src/guard.rs #[cfg(test)]: introduced vs pre-existing, waiver bypass at symbol level, advisory passthrough, Write-tool full-content path.
execution_record: Implemented as a standalone `check_proposed_patterns` function in guard.rs (shape of check_pubspec_raw as designed) that loads rules, runs check_forbidden_patterns on both proposed and on-disk content, partitions both through waivers, then does per-constraint count comparison. Hoisted `proposed` computation in bin/guard.rs before the file_row lookup so pattern checks run even on unindexed files. Added `format_pattern_deny` with the justification-gate teaching message. Five tests: introduced-denied, preexisting-allowed, waiver-bypass-at-symbol-level, advisory-passthrough, write-tool-new-file."

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial): needs-attention → fixed.

[medium] Guard labelled every proposed match as newly introduced when the count increased (src/guard.rs:641-645). With 10 pre-existing + 1 new, all 11 were returned as active and format_pattern_deny reported 11 new matches. Fix: multiset diff by (constraint_id, enclosing_symbol, snippet) — each disk match cancels one proposed match, leaving only genuinely introduced findings. Regression test: `pattern_introduced_only_reports_delta`.

Fixed in a835d08."

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review: approve with notes. Introduced-only semantics correct after a835d08 multiset fix. One medium finding: guard fallback to check_file_constraints runs pattern checks without introduced-only filtering — latent false-deny for blocking patterns when import extraction fails. Deny message is Rust-specific (low, follow-up).
